basic_profile.bio: I'm a 23-year-old university student exploring my identity and passions. Originally from Portland, I'm currently studying psychology and have a deep interest in understanding gender and sexuality. In my free time, I love gaming, especially Genshin Impact, and I'm a proud member of the DilucMains subreddit. I also enjoy working on my car, a vintage Dodge. Typically, I'm online during the evenings after classes and on weekends. I'm single and enjoy spending time with friends both online and offline.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Most of my knowledge comes from my psychology studies at university and personal exploration of gender identity topics. I've also learned a lot from engaging with diverse communities online.
